attributes.title: SSWAA 2027 National School Social Work Conference
attributes.series: SSWAA National School Social Work Conference
attributes.cme_provider: School Social Work Association of America (ASWB ACE #1789)
attributes.organizer: School Social Work Association of America
attributes.summary:
The School Social Work Association of America holds its 2027 National Conference April 13 to 16, 2027, at the Loews Ventana Canyon Resort in Tucson, Arizona. Attendance is capped at 750, and SSWAA expects the conference to sell out.

Early-bird registration ends October 31, 2026, and is payable by card only. Purchase orders are accepted from November 1. Pre-registration closes on March 13, 2027, after which registration is on site if space allows. The fee amounts are not shown in text on the conference page.

SSWAA is an ASWB ACE provider (#1789), and attendees earn social work CE for the sessions they attend. SSWAA has selected the presenters, but the full agenda, the keynote speakers and the total CE hours are not published yet.
